population_caveat: Publisher mixes TED and annual Swedish procurement statistics. Results are per awarded lot with reported bid count, not all notices, all bids, unique companies or primary-CPV-only procurement. No independent raw-row reconciliation was performed.

top_listed_winner.name: Atea Sverige AB and Retriever Sverige AB (tied)

descriptive_comparison.interpretation: A within-publisher descriptive difference across differently composed, historical observed lots; not a causal effect, an independently verified population estimate, win probability, or a supplier-growth customer signal.

competitor_offer.funnel: free non-binding waitlist with voluntary price-range question
advertised_features: free tender monitoring and category statistics
competitor_offer.evidence_type: publisher marketing and prospective price test, not actual subscription sales

concentration_limit: A ranked winner list is not the full denominator or a validated unique-company distribution. Do not compute supplier HHI, market shares, or concentration from these counts.
business_interpretation: Generic tender alerts, winner/buyer statistics and paid supplier intelligence are already advertised by a competitor. CPV7226 appears worth targeted buyer discovery but the 39% single-bid figure does not prove a commercially underserved segment. Test consented supplier decision correctness, time saved and explicit willingness to pay against existing tools before pricing AgentMine.
